app.name: FixLab
onboarding.title: Learn to fix phones safely
onboarding.intro: FixLab teaches smartphone hardware repair, one layer at a time. Please read this before you start.
onboarding.risk.battery.title: Lithium batteries can catch fire
onboarding.risk.battery.body: A punctured, bent or swollen battery can burn violently. Never pry against a battery, and stop if one looks swollen.
onboarding.risk.heat.title: Heat tools can burn you
onboarding.risk.heat.body: Heat is used to soften glue. Hot glass and metal can burn your skin and damage parts inside the phone.
onboarding.risk.glass.title: Broken glass is sharp
onboarding.risk.glass.body: Cracked screens and backs shed sharp pieces. Wear eye protection, and gloves when handling broken glass.
onboarding.risk.own.title: You repair at your own risk
onboarding.risk.own.body: Opening a phone can damage it, end its warranty and cause injury. FixLab is for learning and does not guarantee results. If you are unsure, go to a repair shop.
onboarding.accept: I have read this and I accept the risks

about.title: About & Credits
about.whatBody: FixLab is a free app for learning smartphone hardware repair. It has no ads, no login and no analytics. Your progress stays on your phone.
about.noSources: No external guides are linked yet. When they are, their sources and licenses will be listed here.
about.creditContent: Guides and lessons are written for FixLab. Sample phones are made up for learning.
about.creditArt: Phone and repair illustrations are original, generic drawings. They do not show any real brand or model.
about.creditFont: Headings use Barlow Condensed (SIL Open Font License).
about.creditBuilt: Built with Expo and React Native (MIT License).
